data.body:
[P1] Release checkpoint draining when the deadline passes

If a checkpoint request is still pending when this fires, `terminate()` disables new enqueues and aborts step signals, but the wrapper still awaits `waitForQueueCompletion()` before inspecting the deadline reason. A stalled request therefore delays `InvocationDeadlineError` and cleanup beyond the deadline; queued updates are also sent when it finishes. For deadline termination, abandon unsent updates and release the wrapper's wait without resuming operation callers, while preserving ordinary fault draining. Add a held-request regression that expects the deadline error before releasing the checkpoint.
